=={{header|Cxc}}==

<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
def main:
    use console: Console
    word_for(n: Int) :- String!
        fizz     :- ||: n % 3 == 0 : "Fizz" |?: ""
        buzz     :- ||: n % 5 == 0 : "Buzz" |?: ""
        combined :- fizz + buzz
        combined.not_empty() ?? n.to_string()

    -> running
        self :> tick(1)

    running <: tick(n: Int):
        |:  n > 100 -> end
        |?: -> running
            console.write(self.word_for(n))
            self :> tick(n + 1)
</syntaxhighlight>
